verdict.rationale: Otter documents its own event-driven automations: meeting takeaways automatically become tickets in Zendesk and ServiceNow, and transcripts and summaries are automatically sent to Airtable. Marketing also says teams can trigger actions based on meeting content, and webhooks appear on the pricing page. There is no documented user-facing rule builder for defining conditions and actions; the content-based triggering is described in the context of Public API custom integrations, which is a developer building block. Missing for 10: a documented user-defined rule or condition engine, details of the trigger and event model, webhook event documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Automatically turn meeting takeaways into support tickets or updates in tools like Zendesk and ServiceNow.
Otter automatically sends transcripts, summaries, and meeting metadata to Airtable.
Teams can automatically ingest meeting transcripts into internal knowledge bases or trigger actions based on meeting content
